Internal ID: SpearElderbark | Type: Spear | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Troll hide x3, Iron x15, Ancient bark x15 | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Hitbox: 1.9 range, 40 angle, 1.5 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The ancient bark spear is the third spear. Its primary attack is a melee attack. Its secondary attack throws the spear for 1.5x damage.

Notes. • Like all spears, the ancient bark spear floats if dropped or thrown into water.
